CustomField.formula:
if (isblank(Lunch_End_Proxy__c) && isblank(Lunch_Start_Proxy__c),
(floor (Worker_Time_Out_Proxy__c) + (Worker_Time_Out_Proxy__c - floor (Worker_Time_Out_Proxy__c))/60*100)
-
(floor (Worker_Time_In_Proxy__c) + (Worker_Time_In_Proxy__c - floor (Worker_Time_In_Proxy__c))/60*100),
(floor (Worker_Time_Out_Proxy__c) + (Worker_Time_Out_Proxy__c - floor (Worker_Time_Out_Proxy__c))/60*100)
-
(floor (Worker_Time_In_Proxy__c) + (Worker_Time_In_Proxy__c - floor (Worker_Time_In_Proxy__c))/60*100)
-
((floor ( Lunch_End_Proxy__c ) + (Lunch_End_Proxy__c - floor (Lunch_End_Proxy__c ))/60*100)
-
(floor ( Lunch_Start_Proxy__c ) + (Lunch_Start_Proxy__c - floor (Lunch_Start_Proxy__c ))/60*100)))
CustomField.label: Worker Hours
